_about: Allowlist for scripts/scan-secrets.mjs. Only SYNTHETIC fixture values may be listed here.
A real credential must never be allowlisted: rotate it (revoke and reissue at the provider). Deleting it is not remediation.

Built-in markers (fake, synthetic, example, dummy, notreal, notareal, placeholder, redacted, changeme, xxxxxxxx, your-) already exempt values that contain them (markers of 6+ characters anywhere; shorter markers at a word boundary or repeated). Values of machine-generated token rules (AIza, ya29, apify_api_, llmgtwy_, sk-, ghp_, JWT, Bearer ...) with 10+ character ascending or identical runs (abcdefghij, 0000000000) are also exempt; human-chosen secrets (passwords, URL credentials, secret-named assignments, .env values) and private keys never are.
Prefer generating fixture secrets at test runtime or embedding a marker such as FAKE or SYNTHETIC in the value; use fingerprints only when the value shape cannot carry a marker.

Every entry needs a reason of at least 10 characters; markers need at least 4 characters; ignorePaths entries must be objects with a specific glob (no catch-alls). The scanner refuses to run (exit 2) otherwise. Changes to this file require code-owner review (see .github/CODEOWNERS) and are printed by CI on pull requests.

pathMarkers.reason: Test-only values commonly carry these words, e.g. ya29.test-access-token-0001.

fingerprints.reason: Synthetic test value 'should-not-be-stored' (a plain phrase) used to assert that approval payloads drop secret-named fields.
Synthetic test value (the 'sk-live' prefix followed by the plain phrase 'should never be stored' and digits) used to assert that job results drop secret-named fields.
Synthetic test value 'should-not-affect-hash' (a plain phrase) used to assert that request hashes ignore secret-named params.
